scope: Post-discovery causal diagnosis of previously captured cases. All natural fault families were known before this protocol. No independent blind validation or population prevalence estimate.
questions: Do canonical-only generator arguments explain omitted source-field dependencies across several configurations?
Does one shared dictionary normalization explain both ARC-Challenge and OpenBookQA option corruption?
Do those shared repairs leave a known source-specific LAB-Bench omission unresolved?
Does new primary external evidence connect an affected configuration to a reported conclusion?
selection: Use prior frozen SELECTED records for ARC/OpenBookQA/MMLU. For other captured corpora select up to100 by ascending SHA256 of canonical JSON for complete official record, tied by original index. Keep failures/unknowns. Report reused rows and variants separately.

interventions.bind_source_symbols: Before native prompt resolution, rewrite placeholders for mapped source question/context fields to canonical question/context names. Preserve native formatter and all other template text.
interventions.decode_parallel_choices: Handle only validated label/text parallel-list dictionaries by returning normalized text list. Delegate all other representations to unchanged native normalizer.
interventions.lab_complete_options: For LAB-Bench only, supply ideal followed by distractors as the complete choices field. Explicit source-specific repair.

outcomes: actual captured prompt depends on question nonce
actual captured prompt depends on a nonempty declared context nonce
displayed choice sequence matches official source after edge-whitespace normalization

expected.winogrande: Question dependence restored by symbol binding only.
expected.sciq: Declared support dependence restored by symbol binding; question remains bound.
expected.lab_bench: Shared repairs preserve absent-gold error; explicit source-specific completion required.
expected.arc_challenge: Choice structure restored by parallel-list decoder only.
expected.openbookqa: Both shared repairs needed to restore question dependence and full option sequence.
expected.controls: Native question/choice preservation retained on medmcqa and mmlu.

method: Execute original One-Eval preprocessing and prompt resolver and original locked DataFlow generator/formatter method bodies under previously documented data-only AST scaffold. In-memory storage and local recording serving replace I/O/model. Use actual run entry and captured requests. Zero model inference.

new_leads: One-Eval primary paper experimental endpoint and released artifact pointers
Dataflow-LoopAI captured one_eval.log and matching run code
external_audit.confirmation_requires: Identify actual affected version/configuration and delivered request/output or equivalent original run evidence linked to a reported conclusion. Keep partial use evidence.
